name: harbordeck
description: A desktop desk for everything your agents need from you: decisions, reviews, dispatches and to-dos, answered with a stamp.

scripts.garden: g=${GARDEN:-$HOME/.agents/skills/garden/bin/garden.mjs}; if [ -f "$g" ]; then node "$g" check .; else echo "garden: $g not installed; skipped (see .garden/)"; fi
scripts.check: node --check app/main.js && node --check app/preload.js && node --check app/lib/attach.js && for f in app/renderer/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check cli/src/scheduler.js
